behavior.description: Ingredients spring outward along evenly spaced index-based rays and settle at their existing authored positions, without rearranging the layout.
behavior.totalDuration: duration + max(0, n - 1) * stagger seconds; 0 when n = 0
behavior.indexing: At setup, order targets by numeric data-index, breaking ties by authored DOM order; missing data-index targets follow in DOM order. Assign each target a stable zero-based ordinal i and freeze count n for this application. Reuse this ordering when seeking; do not reindex per frame.
behavior.restoration: At each target's end, hold x=0, y=0, scale=1 and rotation=0 relative to the authored pose, with absolute opacity=1. No residual displacement or spin remains. Before its delay, hold the first keyframe. All state is derived from local time, including rewind.

adaptation.coordinates: x/y are additive design-pixel offsets in scene axes. Scale is a multiplier of authored scale; rotation is added to authored rotation in degrees; opacity is absolute. Preserve static placement and independent decorative transforms.
adaptation.resizing: Map design pixels through the consuming scene's existing 1080x1920 coordinate scale. For a different design frame, choose radius at setup proportional to its smaller dimension and retain the same deterministic index equations.
adaptation.implementation: Formulas are mathematical intent, not executable source. Resolve i, n and parameters once at setup and interpolate the explicit local-time keyframes using the named cubic-bezier curves in any runtime.
